notes: Setup is much shorter: after clicking the Web app URL, a page says ✅ Published! with one button – ▶ Back to HouseRunner setup. No going back to the Sheet, no Sheet menu, no SETUP window.

The step window now leads you one click at a time (17 small steps), says which tab to be in for each, and shows a short zoomed-in clip or picture of exactly what to click. It's bigger, and ends with closing every tab except HouseRunner setup.
Coming back to the setup page part-way (a reload, the browser closed) now carries on where you were, instead of offering to make another copy.
Clicked Done instead of the Web app URL? The Sheet, the step window and Help now say how to use the deployment you already made (Deploy → Manage deployments) rather than deploying again.
A new family's Sheet now shows only its My ID tab – HouseRunner's own data tabs are tucked away (still there, under View → Hidden sheets).
The setup picture in the Sheet is gone, and the Apps Script page now starts with a friendly note: nothing to read or change, just click Deploy.
